prompts.label: Part A · 第 51 题
prompts.prompt: Write a letter to a friend of yours to 1) recommend one of your favorite movies and 2) give reasons for your recommendation. You should write about 100 words on ANSWER SHEET 2. Do not sign your own name at the end of the letter. Use “Li Ming” instead. Do not write the address.

prompts.label: Part B · 第 52 题
prompts.prompt: Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following drawing. In your essay, you should 1) describe the drawing briefly, 2) explain its intended meaning, and 3) give your comments. Your should write neatly on ANSWER SHEET 2.
